title: The Chain Gang Mutiny
logline: Convict laborers seize an unshielded modular prison barge during a gate transit, fleeing across three systems to escape corporate hunters determined to silence proof of criminal radiation neglect.

roles.description: Former commercial pilot serving eight years for union smuggling; navigating the runaway penal barge.
Executive warden for the private correctional corporation; focused on suppressing liability before shareholder meetings.
An aging modular penal hauler with unshielded crew blocks, leaking coolant, and failing attitude thrusters.
A private corporate gunship outfitted with heavy tracking arrays and high-yield torpedo launchers.
The private security syndicate holding transport contracts for planetary correctional ministries.
A high-orbit propellant transfer platform situated along the border jump transit corridor.
An unaligned asteroid trading hub outside corporate jurisdiction that grants sanctuary to stranded crews.

public_situation: System security networks across three systems broadcast urgent pursuit alerts for an armed runaway prison transport barge.
private_truth: {role:penal_contractor_corps} stripped the radiation baffling from {role:prison_barge_hulk} to cut refit costs, knowingly exposing convict crews to lethal stellar flare wash.

beats.public_change: Security alerts echo across {system} as {role:penal_contractor_corps} posts a high-priority bounty for flight telemetry.

missions.reason: The superintendent contracts an independent pilot to analyze gate telemetry buoys to determine which branch corridor the barge entered.
missions.private_fact: He needs the barge destroyed before maritime inspectors can examine its compromised reactor bulkhead.

beats.public_change: Fuel prices spike at border depots as corporate security escorts requisition civilian fuel pods.

missions.reason: The coxswain hails the pilot over encrypted channels, offering seized commissary gold to buy emergency reactor propellant.
missions.private_fact: Half the inmates are already showing early symptoms of radiation sickness from unshielded jump drives.

missions.reason: He pays the pilot to rush an impound warrant to border station fuel brokers to choke off all supplies to the runaway barge.
missions.private_fact: He authorized lethal ordnance for his hunter frigate without waiting for ministerial approval.

beats.public_change: {role:warden_hunter_frigate} engages the runaway barge's outer picket in deep space.

missions.reason: The coxswain contracts the pilot to attack the hunter frigate's scout wing and recover their jump gate clearance keycard.
missions.private_fact: The keycard will unlock the frontier gate into neutral territory before the corporate blockade locks the system down.

beats.public_change: {role:neutral_free_haven} receives conflicting demands to impound or shelter approaching vessels.

missions.reason: The superintendent hires the pilot to deliver an armed extradition demand to haven authorities before the barge arrives.
missions.private_fact: The extradition paperwork claims the inmates murdered their medical staff, concealing that the guards fled first.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds both the haven docking credentials and the corporate extradition writ. The haven will act on the pilot's counsel.

options.label: Certify the mutineers' distress status to guarantee emergency haven docking
Deliver the extradition writ and guide the hunter frigate in for the kill

beats.public_change: {role:warden_hunter_frigate} prepares a terminal torpedo run against {role:prison_barge_hulk} on the perimeter of the haven.

missions.reason: The superintendent pays the pilot to destroy the barge's bridge modules before it crosses into sovereign haven range.
missions.private_fact: The coxswain hails mid-engagement, offering corporate maintenance telemetry proving criminal shielding neglect if the pilot turns and disables the hunter frigate.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot secures docking clearance at the neutral haven.
resolutions.summary: {role:prison_barge_hulk} docks safely at {role:neutral_free_haven}. The surviving convicts claim political asylum, leaving {role:penal_contractor_corps} empty-handed.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot helped an escaped prison transport slip past corporate hunters to claim haven sanctuary.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the coxswain's offer, disables the hunter frigate, and transmits the shielding telemetry.
resolutions.summary: Scandal erupts as records prove {role:penal_contractor_corps} stripped reactor shielding. {role:penal_superintendent} is indicted, and surviving convicts receive medical care.

consequences.public_summary: A gunfighter turned against a private prison armada after uncovering illegal radiation neglect.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the runaway barge on behalf of the superintendent.
resolutions.summary: {role:prison_barge_hulk} is destroyed in deep space. {role:penal_contractor_corps} reports an accidental catastrophic reactor containment failure, burying all evidence.

consequences.public_summary: A hired mercenary silenced an escaped convict ship in deep space for corporate bounty credits.

resolutions.reached_by: Fuel runs out or the pilot avoids taking contracts.
resolutions.summary: {role:prison_barge_hulk} runs out of propellant in an unpatrolled jump corridor. Life-support systems freeze, leaving the hulk to drift indefinitely as a tomb.

loose_threads.detail: Debris from the transport's engine casing shows radiation shielding plates were unbolted and replaced with sheet iron.
A major investment fund divested from {role:penal_contractor_corps} shares hours before the mutiny was reported.
Dock records at {role:neutral_free_haven} record an advance retainer paid by a corporate security front company.

radio_hooks: Multi-system dragnet launched after unconfirmed reports of mutiny aboard a private penal transport.
Border haven authorities reject corporate extradition requests, citing maritime neutrality covenants.
Shares in private correctional syndicates fluctuate wildly as rumors of transport safety failures circulate.

voice_direction.convict_coxswain: Hoarse, urgent, barking commands over ship-wide comms while maintaining professional flight terminology under extreme fire.
voice_direction.penal_superintendent: Smooth, icy corporate executive cadence. Treats human casualties as operational variances and never raises his voice above a murmur.
